summary_md: **cv usk ([@cv_usk](https://x.com/cv_usk/status/2116105580121366676))** explains *StreamVibe* ([arXiv 2610.34662](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.34662)), proactive video agents for explicit, implicit and changing intent, with a 4,100-sample benchmark, SFT plus trajectory-level GRPO that cuts false triggers, and a harness tracking active intents that lifts dynamic F1 from about 59 to 66.
relevance: Proactive agents over live video with a dedicated harness.
